config.name: Kora Café
config.tagline: Good Coffee. Great Food. Better Moments.
config.shortIntro: A sunlit neighborhood café in Mumbai crafted for unhurried mornings, comforting plates, and honest, everyday pricing.
config.streetAddress: 14th Road, Off Linking Road, Bandra West
config.landmark: Near National College & Pali Hill Corner

menu.name: House Classic Cappuccino
menu.description: Double-shot Chikmagalur Arabica espresso topped with velvety steamed milk microfoam.

menu.name: South Indian Filter Kaapi
menu.description: Slow-dripped peaberry decoction frothed with farm milk and light jaggery sweetness.

menu.name: Cinnamon Hazelnut Latte
menu.description: Smooth double espresso steamed with roasted hazelnut syrup and a warm Ceylon cinnamon finish.

menu.name: Manual V60 Pour Over
menu.description: Single-estate Bababudangiri light roast brewed clean to highlight cocoa and citrus notes.

menu.name: Signature Iced Cold Brew Latte
menu.description: 18-hour steeped estate cold brew layered over ice with silky milk and raw cane syrup.

menu.name: Mumbai Classic Frappe
menu.description: Chilled espresso blended thick with Belgian cocoa, cream, and roasted coffee nibs.

menu.name: Espresso Orange Tonic
menu.description: Crisp chilled tonic water, fresh Nagpur orange zest, and a double shot of espresso.

menu.name: Bombay Adrak Elaichi Chai
menu.description: Assam CTC brewed slow with crushed ginger, green cardamom, and whole milk.

menu.name: Peach & Mint Iced Tea
menu.description: House-brewed Nilgiri black tea shaken cold with ripe peach purée and fresh garden mint.

menu.name: Spiced Dark Hot Chocolate
menu.description: 55% dark couverture melted into steamed milk with a pinch of nutmeg and sea salt.

menu.name: Smashed Avocado & Poached Egg Toast
menu.description: Country sourdough layered with lime-herbed avocado, soft poached egg, toasted sesame, and chilli flakes.

menu.name: Bun Maska & Berry Jam Platter
menu.description: Warm toasted Irani-style milk bun generously whipped with cultured butter and house strawberry compote.

menu.name: Masala Omelette & Herbed Hash
menu.description: Three-egg fluffy omelette with onions, coriander, and green chillies, served with sourdough toast.

menu.name: Bombay Pesto & Mozzarella Panini
menu.description: Crisp grilled sourdough stuffed with fresh basil-coriander chutney pesto, mozzarella, and vine tomato.

menu.name: Smoked Chicken & Garlic Aioli Club
menu.description: Pulled herb-roasted chicken, caramelised onions, crunchy lettuce, and house garlic mayo on multigrain.

menu.name: Truffle & Rosemary Peri Fries
menu.description: Hand-cut crispy skin-on fries tossed with roasted garlic salt and warm parmesan dip.

menu.name: Creamy Basil Pesto Penne
menu.description: Al dente penne tossed in stone-ground basil pesto, blistered cherry tomatoes, toasted pine nuts, and parmesan.

menu.name: Slow-Simmered Arrabbiata Spaghetti
menu.description: San Marzano style tomato sauce with roasted garlic, basil oil, olives, and toasted garlic bread.

menu.name: Herb Grilled Chicken Rice Bowl
menu.description: Paprika-marinated chicken breast over buttered garlic rice, sautéed greens, and lemon pepper jus.

menu.name: Espresso Tiramisu
menu.description: Savoiardi biscuits soaked in our house espresso, layered with whipped mascarpone and dark cocoa dust.

menu.name: French Butter Croissant
menu.description: Flaky 27-layer laminated pastry baked golden every morning, served warm with sea-salt butter.

menu.name: Warm Belgian Walnut Brownie
menu.description: Fudgy dark chocolate brownie studded with roasted Kashmir walnuts; add vanilla gelato for ₹50.

gallery.title: Sunlit Main Dining Room
gallery.alt: Sunlit Mumbai café interior with arched windows, indoor plants, and warm wood dining tables
gallery.caption: Morning light through arched windows — calm seating for work, study, and unhurried conversations.

gallery.title: Rattan Reading & Work Nook
gallery.alt: Cozy corner seating with woven rattan armchairs and marble bistro table beside sunlit window
gallery.caption: Comfortable rattan corners equipped with power outlets and natural daylight.

gallery.title: Morning Pour & Latte Craft
gallery.alt: Barista pouring steamed microfoam latte art into a handmade stoneware cup on walnut counter
gallery.caption: Single-estate Indian Arabica dialled in fresh every morning at the espresso bar.

gallery.title: Iced Cold Brew Swirl
gallery.alt: Iced cold brew coffee in fluted glass with cream swirl on travertine coaster
gallery.caption: 18-hour cold brew built for warm Mumbai afternoons.

gallery.title: All-Day Table Spread
gallery.alt: Overhead spread of tulip cappuccino, spiced chai, grilled panini sandwich, and butter croissants
gallery.caption: Chai, cappuccino, flaky croissants, and grilled paninis meant to be shared.

gallery.title: Sourdough Avocado Toast
gallery.alt: Crispy sourdough toast topped with smashed avocado, poached egg, and toasted sesame seeds
gallery.caption: Fresh kitchen breakfast plates prepared to order from 8:00 AM.

gallery.title: Stone-Ground Basil Pesto Penne
gallery.alt: Bowl of creamy basil pesto penne pasta with roasted cherry tomatoes and pine nuts
gallery.caption: Comforting lunch & dinner bowls priced fairly for everyday visits.

gallery.title: Espresso Tiramisu & Croissant
gallery.alt: Espresso-soaked tiramisu dusted with cocoa alongside a freshly baked butter croissant
gallery.caption: Fresh bakes and house-made desserts every afternoon.
